# Sign in

Use your work account to continue to Example Workspace. Your session will stay signed in on this device for fourteen days unless you sign out or your administrator ends it.

If your organisation uses single sign-on, enter your email address and you will be redirected to your identity provider. Two-step verification may be required by your workspace policy.

Don't have an account? [Create one](https://login-page.example.test/signup) · [Forgot your password?](https://login-page.example.test/password/reset)
